strategies.hypothesis: After 11:00, if price is in the top 10% of the day's range, has held above VWAP for 90% of bars and extended above the first hour, hold long to the close.

entry.long: tod() >= 660 and close > session().high - 0.1*(session().high - session().low) and count(close > vwap(), 18) >= 16 and session().high > opening_range(60).high
entry.short: tod() >= 660 and close < session().low + 0.1*(session().high - session().low) and count(close < vwap(), 18) >= 16 and session().low < opening_range(60).low

strategies.name: CCI +100 trend entry (Lambert)
strategies.mechanism: price moving well above its statistical mean starts a cyclical up-move
strategies.hypothesis: CCI crossing above +100 marks the start of an up-cycle; exit when it falls back below +100.

strategies.name: Stochastic pop (momentum thrust)
strategies.mechanism: an overbought reading after a quiet period is strength, not weakness
strategies.hypothesis: When %K pushes above 80 while ADX is still below 20 (a new move out of a range), momentum continues until %K drops below 70.

strategies.name: Momentum ignition (ROC shock)
strategies.mechanism: unusually large short-horizon returns attract momentum followers
strategies.hypothesis: A 5-bar return more than two standard deviations above its recent distribution continues briefly; trail an ATR stop.

strategies.name: Awesome Oscillator saucer
strategies.mechanism: a brief dip in momentum above zero precedes the next thrust
strategies.hypothesis: With AO above zero, two falling AO bars followed by a rising bar mark the end of a pause.

entry.long: ao() > 0 and ao()[1] < ao()[2] and ao()[2] < ao()[3] and ao() > ao()[1]
entry.short: ao() < 0 and ao()[1] > ao()[2] and ao()[2] > ao()[3] and ao() < ao()[1]

strategies.name: Momentum Pinball (Raschke)
strategies.mechanism: short-term oversold daily momentum resolves by a first-hour breakout
strategies.anchor: RSI(3) of daily 1-day ROC + first-hour range
strategies.hypothesis: When RSI(3) of the daily 1-day rate of change is below 30, buy a break above the first hour's high.

evidence.note: Momentum Pinball (book; rules not read here)

strategies.name: RSI(2) pullback in an uptrend (Connors)
strategies.mechanism: short pullbacks inside a longer uptrend revert
strategies.hypothesis: With price above its 200-bar average, an RSI(2) reading below 5 is a buying opportunity; exit on a close above the 5-bar average.
strategies.notes: Originally daily bars; intraday use is an adaptation.

strategies.name: Bollinger Band re-entry fade
strategies.mechanism: closes back inside the band after a 2-sd excursion revert to the mean
strategies.hypothesis: A close back above the lower band after closing below it reverts toward the 20-bar mean.

strategies.name: Internal bar strength reversal
strategies.mechanism: closes at the very bottom of a bar's range tend to be followed by bounces
strategies.hypothesis: A bar closing in the bottom 15% of its range above the 200-bar average bounces; exit when IBS > 0.7 or after 5 bars.

strategies.name: Consecutive down closes reversion
strategies.mechanism: runs of same-direction closes exhaust short-term order flow
strategies.hypothesis: Four or more consecutive lower closes above the 200-bar EMA bounce; exit on the first higher close.

strategies.name: TD Sequential setup-9 exhaustion
strategies.mechanism: nine closes against the close 4 bars earlier marks exhaustion
strategies.hypothesis: When the buy-setup count reaches 9, the decline is exhausted; buy with a stop under the setup's low.

strategies.name: Regression-channel reversion
strategies.mechanism: deviations from a fitted trend line revert while the trend holds
strategies.hypothesis: A close more than two residual standard deviations below the 100-bar regression line reverts toward the line.

strategies.name: Volatility-shock bar reversal
strategies.mechanism: panic bars overshoot fair value and partially retrace
strategies.hypothesis: A bar whose range exceeds 3 ATR and closes near its extreme retraces part of the move over the next bars.

entry.long: high - low > 3*atr(14)[1] and close < low + 0.25*(high - low)
entry.short: high - low > 3*atr(14)[1] and close > high - 0.25*(high - low)

strategies.name: Mass Index reversal bulge (Dorsey)
strategies.mechanism: range expansion then contraction marks trend exhaustion
strategies.hypothesis: After the Mass Index rises above 27 and falls back below 26.5, trade against the prevailing 9-EMA direction.

entry.long: within(mass_index(9,25) > 27, 10) and cross_below(mass_index(9,25), 26.5) and ema(close,9) < ema(close,9)[5]
entry.short: within(mass_index(9,25) > 27, 10) and cross_below(mass_index(9,25), 26.5) and ema(close,9) > ema(close,9)[5]

strategies.name: RSI bullish/bearish divergence
strategies.mechanism: momentum failing to confirm a new price extreme
strategies.hypothesis: A new 20-bar low with RSI(14) higher than at the previous 20-bar low shows waning selling; buy on the next up close.

entry.long: low <= lowest(low,20) and rsi(close,14) > valuewhen(low <= lowest(low,20), rsi(close,14))[5] and close > open
entry.short: high >= highest(high,20) and rsi(close,14) < valuewhen(high >= highest(high,20), rsi(close,14))[5] and close < open

strategies.name: Bollinger squeeze breakout
strategies.mechanism: volatility compression precedes expansion
strategies.hypothesis: When Bollinger bandwidth is near its 120-bar low, the next close outside the bands starts an expansion move.

strategies.name: NR7 breakout bracket (Crabel)
strategies.mechanism: the narrowest bar of seven precedes range expansion
strategies.hypothesis: After the narrowest-range bar of the last seven, a bracket (one-cancels-other) at its high and low catches the expansion.

strategies.name: Keltner channel breakout
strategies.mechanism: closes beyond an ATR band signal directional expansion
strategies.hypothesis: A close above the upper Keltner band continues until price closes back below the midline.

strategies.name: Range-expansion bar continuation
strategies.mechanism: an unusually wide bar closing at its extreme shows urgent one-sided demand
strategies.hypothesis: A bar with true range above twice ATR(20) that closes in its top 20% continues over the next few bars.

entry.long: high - low > 2*atr(20)[1] and close > high - 0.2*(high - low) and rvol(20) > 1.5
entry.short: high - low > 2*atr(20)[1] and close < low + 0.2*(high - low) and rvol(20) > 1.5

strategies.distinct: Continuation after a wide bar; shock_bar_reversal fades wider bars that close at the extreme opposite.

strategies.name: Engulfing candle at a 10-bar extreme
strategies.mechanism: a full-body reversal at a local extreme
strategies.hypothesis: A bullish engulfing bar whose low is the lowest of 10 bars signals a local reversal.

evidence.note: no value vs random trading on DJIA stocks

strategies.name: Hammer / shooting star at prior-session level
strategies.mechanism: long rejection wick at a known level
strategies.hypothesis: A hammer whose low tests yesterday's low (within 0.2 ATR) shows rejection of lower prices.

definition.name: Hammer / shooting star at prior-session level

evidence.note: no value vs random trading on DJIA stocks

strategies.name: Morning star / evening star
strategies.mechanism: selling climax, indecision, then demand
strategies.hypothesis: A strong bearish bar, a small indecision bar and a bullish close above the first bar's midpoint mark a turn.

evidence.note: no value vs random trading on DJIA stocks

strategies.name: Three white soldiers / three black crows continuation
strategies.mechanism: three strong same-direction closes show sustained demand
strategies.hypothesis: Three rising bullish bars opening inside the prior body and closing near highs continue the move.

definition.name: Three white soldiers / three black crows continuation

evidence.note: no value vs random trading on DJIA stocks

strategies.name: Outside-bar reversal
strategies.mechanism: a bar engulfing the prior range and closing strong reverses a down-move
strategies.hypothesis: After a 5-bar decline, an outside bar closing in its top quarter reverses the move.

entry.long: candle().outside == 1 and close > high - 0.25*(high - low) and close[1] < close[6]
entry.short: candle().outside == 1 and close < low + 0.25*(high - low) and close[1] > close[6]

evidence.note: no value vs random trading on DJIA stocks

strategies.name: Break of structure after a higher low
strategies.mechanism: a close above the last swing high after a higher low confirms an up-trend
strategies.hypothesis: Once a higher swing low is in place, a close above the most recent swing high starts the next leg.

definition.name: Break of structure after a higher low

strategies.notes: Swings are published only after confirmation (3 bars), so no repainting.

strategies.name: Double bottom / double top
strategies.mechanism: two failed tests of the same level followed by a neckline break
strategies.anchor: last two swing lows + intervening swing high
strategies.hypothesis: Two swing lows within 0.3 ATR of each other followed by a close above the swing high between them complete a double bottom.

strategies.name: Head-and-shoulders breakdown
strategies.mechanism: a failed higher high between two lower peaks, then neckline break
strategies.hypothesis: A head at least 0.5 ATR above two shoulders that are within 1 ATR of each other, then a close below the latest swing low, reverses the trend.

entry.short: swings(3).high_prev > swings(3).high + 0.5*atr(14) and swings(3).high_prev > swings(3).high_prev2 + 0.5*atr(14) and abs(swings(3).high - swings(3).high_prev2) < atr(14) and cross_below(close, swings(3).low)
entry.long: swings(3).low_prev < swings(3).low - 0.5*atr(14) and swings(3).low_prev < swings(3).low_prev2 - 0.5*atr(14) and abs(swings(3).low - swings(3).low_prev2) < atr(14) and cross_above(close, swings(3).high)

strategies.name: Flag after an impulse
strategies.mechanism: shallow, low-volume consolidation after an impulse is a pause, not a reversal
strategies.hypothesis: After a 5-bar move of more than 3 ATR, a 6-bar consolidation under half that size on falling volume breaks out in the impulse direction.

entry.long: change(close,11)[6] > 3*atr(14) and highest(high,6) - lowest(low,6) < 0.5*change(close,5)[6] and mean(volume,6) < mean(volume,5)[6] and close > highest(high,6)[1]
entry.short: change(close,11)[6] < -3*atr(14) and highest(high,6) - lowest(low,6) < -0.5*change(close,5)[6] and mean(volume,6) < mean(volume,5)[6] and close < lowest(low,6)[1]

strategies.name: Converging-range (triangle) breakout
strategies.mechanism: converging highs and lows compress then resolve
strategies.anchor: 20-bar regression slopes of highs and lows
strategies.hypothesis: With highs trending down and lows trending up over 20 bars, a close outside the 20-bar range resolves the triangle.

entry.long: linreg(high,20).slope < 0 and linreg(low,20).slope > 0 and close > highest(high,20)[1]
entry.short: linreg(high,20).slope < 0 and linreg(low,20).slope > 0 and close < lowest(low,20)[1]

strategies.name: Fair-value-gap fill continuation
strategies.mechanism: price returns to an inefficient three-bar gap, then resumes
strategies.hypothesis: In an uptrend, the first return into a bullish fair-value gap that closes above its bottom resumes the trend.

entry.long: close > ema(close,50) and low <= fvg().bull_top and close > fvg().bull_bottom and close > open
entry.short: close < ema(close,50) and high >= fvg().bear_bottom and close < fvg().bear_top and close < open

strategies.name: Fibonacci 50-61.8% retracement entry
strategies.mechanism: traders watch fixed retracement ratios of the last swing
strategies.hypothesis: In an up-leg, a pullback into 50-61.8% of the latest swing that closes bullish resumes the trend.

entry.long: swings(3).high > swings(3).low and close < swings(3).high - 0.5*(swings(3).high - swings(3).low) and low > swings(3).high - 0.618*(swings(3).high - swings(3).low) - 0.1*atr(14) and close > open
entry.short: swings(3).high > swings(3).low and close > swings(3).low + 0.5*(swings(3).high - swings(3).low) and high < swings(3).low + 0.618*(swings(3).high - swings(3).low) + 0.1*atr(14) and close < open

strategies.name: Choppy-regime range trading
strategies.mechanism: in choppy regimes, range extremes hold
strategies.hypothesis: When the Choppiness Index is above 61.8, buy near the 20-bar low and sell near the 20-bar high.

entry.long: chop(14) > 61.8 and low <= lowest(low,20)[1] + 0.1*atr(14) and close > open
entry.short: chop(14) > 61.8 and high >= highest(high,20)[1] - 0.1*atr(14) and close < open

strategies.name: Swing trendline break
strategies.mechanism: a line through the last two lower swing highs is a visible resistance
strategies.anchor: line through two confirmed swing highs
strategies.hypothesis: When price closes above the line connecting the last two descending swing highs (projected to now), the down-trend has broken.

entry.long: swings(3).high < swings(3).high_prev and swings(3).low < swings(3).low_prev and cross_above(close, swings(3).high)
entry.short: swings(3).low > swings(3).low_prev and swings(3).high > swings(3).high_prev and cross_below(close, swings(3).low)

strategies.notes: Implemented as the break of the latest lower swing high in a down-trend (a horizontal proxy of the trendline); break_of_structure instead requires a higher low (continuation).

strategies.name: Relative-volume new session high
strategies.mechanism: unusual same-time-of-day volume marks news/attention flow
strategies.anchor: rvol vs same time of day
strategies.hypothesis: A new session high on at least three times the usual volume for that time of day continues.

strategies.name: Volume-climax reversal
strategies.mechanism: capitulation volume with a rejection wick exhausts sellers
strategies.anchor: rvol > 4 + long lower wick at session low
strategies.hypothesis: A bar at the session low with 4x volume and a lower wick over 60% of its range marks capitulation.

entry.long: rvol(20) > 4 and low <= session().low and min(open, close) - low > 0.6*(high - low)
entry.short: rvol(20) > 4 and high >= session().high and high - max(open, close) > 0.6*(high - low)

strategies.name: On-balance-volume divergence
strategies.mechanism: volume flow leads price (Granville)
strategies.hypothesis: A new 20-bar price low without a new 20-bar OBV low shows accumulation; buy on the next up close.

entry.long: low <= lowest(low,20) and obv() > lowest(obv(),20)[1] and close > open
entry.short: high >= highest(high,20) and obv() < highest(obv(),20)[1] and close < open

strategies.name: Money Flow Index extreme reversal
strategies.mechanism: volume-weighted oversold readings revert
strategies.hypothesis: MFI crossing back above 20 after being below it reverts upward.
strategies.distinct: Uses price x volume; rsi2_pullback uses price only.

strategies.name: Chaikin Money Flow trend confirmation
strategies.mechanism: closes near bar highs on volume indicate accumulation
strategies.hypothesis: CMF crossing above +0.1 with price above EMA(50) confirms accumulation in an up-trend.

strategies.name: Force-index pullback (Elder)
strategies.mechanism: short-term selling pressure inside an up-trend
strategies.hypothesis: With the 13-bar EMA rising, a negative 2-bar force index marks a pullback to buy.

entry.long: force(2) < 0 and ema(close,13) > ema(close,13)[1] and close > ema(close,50)
entry.short: force(2) > 0 and ema(close,13) < ema(close,13)[1] and close < ema(close,50)

strategies.name: Volume dry-up then breakout
strategies.mechanism: quiet volume in a tight range precedes a volume-backed breakout
strategies.hypothesis: After five bars with under 60% of normal volume in a narrowing range, a breakout on twice normal volume continues.

entry.long: mean(volume,5)[1] < 0.6*mean(volume,50)[1] and rvol(20) > 2 and close > highest(high,5)[1]
entry.short: mean(volume,5)[1] < 0.6*mean(volume,50)[1] and rvol(20) > 2 and close < lowest(low,5)[1]

strategies.name: Elder impulse system turn
strategies.mechanism: agreement of trend (EMA13) and momentum (MACD histogram) slopes
strategies.hypothesis: The first bar where both the 13-EMA and the MACD histogram rise ('green') after a non-green bar starts a buyable impulse; exit on red.

entry.long: ema(close,13) > ema(close,13)[1] and macd(close,12,26,9).hist > macd(close,12,26,9).hist[1] and not (ema(close,13)[1] > ema(close,13)[2] and macd(close,12,26,9).hist[1] > macd(close,12,26,9).hist[2])
entry.short: ema(close,13) < ema(close,13)[1] and macd(close,12,26,9).hist < macd(close,12,26,9).hist[1] and not (ema(close,13)[1] < ema(close,13)[2] and macd(close,12,26,9).hist[1] < macd(close,12,26,9).hist[2])

strategies.notes: The impulse system appears in Elder's later book 'Come into My Trading Room', which was not verified here.

strategies.name: Intraday momentum: first half-hour predicts the last
strategies.mechanism: late-day trading by informed/hedging participants continues the morning's direction
strategies.anchor: return from prior close to 10:00 ET
strategies.hypothesis: At 15:30 ET, take a position in the direction of the return from the prior close to 10:00 ET; exit at the close.

definition.name: Intraday momentum: first half-hour predicts the last

strategies.notes: Exit is 5 minutes before the close (platform rule), so the last 5 minutes of the paper's window are not captured.

strategies.name: Same-time-of-day return persistence
strategies.mechanism: returns at the same half-hour recur across days
strategies.anchor: mean 30-minute return at this time over 20 sessions
strategies.hypothesis: Hold for 30 minutes when the average return of this half-hour over the last 20 sessions is significantly positive (t > 2).

evidence.note: cross-sectional half-hour continuation; time-series use here is an adaptation

strategies.name: Turn-of-the-month intraday long
strategies.mechanism: month-end/start flows lift equities
strategies.anchor: last day and first 3 days of the month
strategies.hypothesis: Hold SPY long from the first bar's close to the close on the last trading day of the month and the first three days of the next.

evidence.note: daily close-to-close monthly effect; intraday-only here

strategies.name: Pre-holiday session long
strategies.mechanism: positive returns before market holidays
strategies.hypothesis: Hold the index long intraday on the last session before a market holiday.

strategies.name: Option-expiration pinning reversion
strategies.mechanism: hedging flows pin optionable stocks near strikes on expiration day
strategies.anchor: nearest $5 strike on the third Friday
strategies.hypothesis: On monthly expiration Fridays after 13:00, fade moves more than 0.5% away from the nearest $5 strike back toward it.

entry.short: is_opex() == 1 and tod() >= 780 and close > (floor_to(close,5) + 2.5) and close / (floor_to(close,5) + 5) - 1 > -0.001 and close < open
entry.long: is_opex() == 1 and tod() >= 780 and close < (floor_to(close,5) + 2.5) and close / floor_to(close,5) - 1 < 0.001 and close > open

evidence.note: closing prices cluster at strikes on expiration dates

strategies.notes: Uses $5 strike spacing as an approximation; real strikes vary by stock and price.

strategies.name: Lunchtime reversal of the morning trend
strategies.mechanism: morning trend participants take profits during the lunch lull
strategies.hypothesis: Between 11:30 and 13:30, fade a morning trend of more than 0.7% when a reversal bar closes back through the 20-bar EMA.

definition.name: Lunchtime reversal of the morning trend

entry.short: time_between("11:30", "13:30") and close / session().open - 1 > 0.007 and cross_below(close, ema(close,20))
entry.long: time_between("11:30", "13:30") and close / session().open - 1 < -0.007 and cross_above(close, ema(close,20))

strategies.name: Pre-FOMC announcement drift (intraday part)
strategies.mechanism: equities rise ahead of scheduled FOMC announcements
strategies.hypothesis: On FOMC announcement days, hold the index long from the first bar's close until 13:55 ET, before the 14:00 statement.

evidence.note: 24-hour pre-announcement window; only the same-day part is traded

strategies.name: Macro-announcement-day long (CPI)
strategies.mechanism: announcement-day risk premium
strategies.hypothesis: On CPI release days, hold the index long from the first bar's close to the close.

strategies.name: Earnings-day opening-range breakout
strategies.mechanism: earnings days concentrate information and attention
strategies.hypothesis: On the session after a company reports, trade the 15-minute opening-range breakout in the gap's direction.

entry.long: event("earnings") == 1 and session().gap > 0 and cross_above(close, opening_range(15).high)
entry.short: event("earnings") == 1 and session().gap < 0 and cross_below(close, opening_range(15).low)

strategies.notes: Needs an earnings calendar; without it the event rule is unknown and the bot never trades (reported as data unavailable).

strategies.name: Intraday relative strength vs the index
strategies.mechanism: stocks leading the market on the day attract flows
strategies.hypothesis: A stock up at least 1% more than SPY since the open, holding above VWAP, keeps outperforming into the afternoon.

definition.name: Intraday relative strength vs the index

entry.long: close / session().open - sym($bench, close / session().open) > 0.01 and close > vwap() and minutes_since_open() >= 60
entry.short: close / session().open - sym($bench, close / session().open) < -0.01 and close < vwap() and minutes_since_open() >= 60

strategies.name: Beta-adjusted residual reversion
strategies.mechanism: idiosyncratic deviations from the market revert
strategies.anchor: z-score of the 60-bar beta-adjusted spread vs SPY
strategies.hypothesis: When a stock's log price minus beta times SPY's falls two standard deviations below its 60-bar mean, it reverts.

evidence.note: daily residual mean reversion with ETF factors; intraday single-leg adaptation

failure_modes: single leg: carries market risk that the paper hedged

strategies.name: ETH/BTC ratio reversion
strategies.mechanism: relative mispricing between close substitutes reverts
strategies.hypothesis: Trade the ETH-BTC product when its log price is more than 2 standard deviations from its 200-bar mean.
strategies.notes: Spot ETH-BTC cannot be shorted on spot venues; only the long side trades unless a margin venue is used.

strategies.name: Leader-to-laggard catch-up
strategies.mechanism: information reaches the leading asset first and diffuses slowly
strategies.hypothesis: When the leader (BTC) rises more than 1% in 15 minutes and the follower has moved less than half as much, buy the follower.

strategies.name: VIX-spike capitulation buy
strategies.mechanism: fear spikes overshoot
strategies.anchor: VIX change vs prior close + SPY below VWAP band
strategies.hypothesis: When VIX is up more than 10% on the day and SPY closes back inside its lower 2-sd VWAP band, buy SPY for a rebound.

entry.long: sym("^VIX", close) / sym("^VIX", session().prev_close) - 1 > 0.10 and cross_above(close, vwap().lower2)

strategies.notes: Uses Yahoo's ^VIX index series.

strategies.name: Perpetual-spot basis reversion
strategies.mechanism: perpetual prices are tied to spot by funding; extreme basis mean-reverts
strategies.anchor: z-score of OKX BTC perp / spot - 1
strategies.hypothesis: Short the perpetual when its premium over spot is more than 2.5 standard deviations above its 1-day mean; long when below.
strategies.notes: Runs on the OKX BTC-USDT perpetual (shortable). OKX availability to Canadian residents was not checked.

strategies.name: US-venue premium momentum
strategies.mechanism: US demand shows up first as a Coinbase premium
strategies.hypothesis: When the Coinbase premium over OKX rises above +2 standard deviations of its 1-day history, buy BTC on Coinbase.
strategies.notes: Premium includes USDT/USD drift; stablecoin de-pegs distort it.

strategies.name: Weekend (CME-hours) gap fill
strategies.mechanism: price tends to revisit the level where the regulated futures market closed on Friday
strategies.anchor: spot at Friday 21:00 UTC vs Sunday 23:00 UTC
strategies.hypothesis: If bitcoin re-opens the week more than 1% away from Friday's 21:00 UTC price, trade back toward that level during Monday (UTC).

entry.short: dow() == 0 and weekend(21,23).gap > 0.01 and close > weekend(21,23).fri_close and close < open
entry.long: dow() == 0 and weekend(21,23).gap < -0.01 and close < weekend(21,23).fri_close and close > open

strategies.notes: 21:00/23:00 UTC approximate CME hours in summer; one hour later in winter.

strategies.name: Monday breakout of the weekend range
strategies.mechanism: thin weekend ranges are broken when institutional flow returns
strategies.hypothesis: On Monday (UTC), a close beyond the weekend's range continues.

definition.name: Monday breakout of the weekend range

strategies.name: Stablecoin peg reversion
strategies.mechanism: redemption arbitrage pulls fully-backed stablecoins back to $1
strategies.hypothesis: Buy a major stablecoin trading below 0.998 USD; sell at 0.9995 or the session end.
failure_modes: a real de-peg does not revert
fees exceed the spread captured at retail tiers

strategies.name: Derivatives-led volume spike fade
strategies.mechanism: moves driven by leveraged perp volume without spot volume are fragile
strategies.hypothesis: When perpetual volume exceeds 5x its usual ratio to spot volume during a sharp move, fade the move.
strategies.notes: Perp volume is in contracts and spot in coins, so only the z-score (not the level) is meaningful.

strategies.name: Funding-rate extreme contrarian
strategies.mechanism: crowded leveraged positioning (extreme funding) unwinds
strategies.hypothesis: When the latest funding rate is above +0.05% per 8h, fade intraday strength in the perpetual; below -0.03%, buy weakness.

strategies.name: Pre-funding-settlement drift
